scope: One saf-test namespace on the lab's pinned kind Kubernetes v1.36.1: server-side Pod admission applies LimitRange default requests and limits and denies per-container CPU, memory, or ephemeral-storage limits above configured maxima; two harmless, small Pods consume aggregate requests.cpu, requests.memory, and requests.ephemeral-storage quota, and separate dry-run candidates exceed each quota. This demonstrates API admission and declared-request accounting only. It does not measure live CPU, memory, or disk consumption, provide GPU hardware or device-plugin evidence, validate policy governance, or establish namespace-wide rollout.

checks.claim: Without a LimitRange, an omitted-resource Pod remains un-defaulted

Without a LimitRange, the ephemeral-storage over-maximum candidate reaches admission
Without a ResourceQuota, the cpu aggregate-overage candidate reaches admission
Without a ResourceQuota, the memory aggregate-overage candidate reaches admission
